content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP® Certification in Portland

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's specific hour requirements for your background—typically a bachelor's degree paired with relevant work experience, or an alternative pathway. Granite PM Academy's admissions team can clarify which route applies to you before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP® prep course. All sessions are delivered online, allowing you to learn from anywhere while maintaining your Portland-area career. Our active certified practitioners guide you through the PMBOK® framework, exam domains, and real-world applications over the structured program.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your 35 contact hours, submit your formal PMP® application directly to PMI, documenting your education and project experience. Pay the required exam fee to PMI at that time. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on the application process to ensure accuracy and timely submission.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor Q&A sessions—to reinforce your knowledge. Schedule your proctored exam through PMI's testing partner. You may sit for the computer-based exam at an authorized testing center or via remote proctoring, on your preferred date.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: PMP® certification is valid for three years. During each renewal cycle, earn professional development units (PDUs) through approved training, volunteer work, or publication. Granite PM Academy offers PDU-eligible courses to help you stay current and keep your credential active throughout your career.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
